paragraphs.text:
While you hug the earth, more undersized gray men enter the 
glen—and so does another figure, a tall, spindly shape cloaked 
in deerskin. The gray ones form a circle and commence a slow, 
shuffling  dance  around  the  light. The  one  who  performed  the 
sacrifice picks up the fallen head and offers it, with reverence, to 
the cowled figure. The latter lets her wrap fall away. She stands 
revealed as an old Caucasian woman of frightful, imposing aspect.

The woman accepts the head from the shaman and intones 
a wavering chant. She lifts the bleeding trophy above her head 
and accepts its blood, a hideous libation upon her hoary locks.

You hear a rhythmic crinkling sound mixed with buzzing in 
the air overhead.
To look up, go to 249. To close your eyes and crawl away, go to 250.
